items.title: Review: The Witch's Bakery (Switch 2) – A Cosy Narrative Sim That Rises To The Occasion
items.summary: Pain and pain au chocolat. Is there a scent more heartwarming than freshly baked bread? French developer Sunny Lab and publisher Silver Lining Interactive don’t think so, if The Witch’s Bakery is anything to go by. This narrative-led adventure sim is filled with cute characters, emotional stories, and pastries. And although you can’t smell the baked goods themselves, you can immerse yourself in Parisian – and otherworldly – wonderlands.
